descriptionNullable:
CASMI 2026 candidate pool: training structures together with COCONUT structures (metadata, fingerprints, fragment masses).

## Licence note (updated 2026-10-13)

No source code in this dataset (the code that reads it is the MIT-licensed `casmi` package in casmi26-v4b-models / casmi26-v3-models). Built only from the competition's `train.parquet` and COCONUT (CC BY 4.0, please keep the attribution). The competition host has clarified (discussion 745072) that `train.parquet` should be treated as open source and that datasets which are non-commercial only through `train.parquet` are fine to use.
